description: Get a single recording's metadata: title, description, duration, pipeline stage (uploading → transcoding → transcribing → annotating → ready), the statuses of its transcript, AI summary, and key moments, and expectedResult: what the person who recorded it expected to happen. When expectedResult is set, read the recording with it in mind: if what the recording shows differs from it, that difference is likely what the user wants looked at, and what matches it is intended. Null means nobody stated it (most recordings).

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name: get_recording
